risks.risk: Internal compressor or cooling system may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit plugged in and running with a thermometer showing a drop in temperature.

risks.risk: The unit may be a generic or low-value brand rather than a high-end split system.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the back or side).

risks.risk: The unit may be missing the indoor unit or the compressor may be seized.
risks.proof: A photo of the indoor unit and a video of the compressor being tested.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the back or side).
Video of the unit plugged in and running.
Photo of the indoor unit if it is included.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
